ValidationRule.description: Blocks CS approval and downstream creation until the required Builder PO header fields exist.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "CS Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Work Order Created"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed") ), OR( ISBLANK(PO_Number__c), ISBLANK(Builder_Division__r.Id), ISBLANK(Community__r.Id), ISBLANK(Lot__r.Id), ISBLANK(TEXT(Requested_Install_Date__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete the PO header before CS approval or work order creation.
